title: High Pressure Response Procedure
summary: Verify Valve-04 position and Pump-02 operating condition.

steps.detail: Cross-check transmitter PIT-02-PRS against backup local gauge PI-02B to rule out instrumentation failure.
steps.safety_note: Do not enter containment valve pit if line is hammering.

steps.detail: Inspect actuator control signal and mechanical indicator on Valve-04 (VLV-04-POS). Verify if positioner commanded reduction to 43% or physical blockage exists.
steps.safety_note: Ensure bypass line is isolated before manual jog.

steps.detail: Check motor current (MOT-02-CUR), casing vibration, and bearing temperatures. Inspect for cavitation or excessive recirculation backpressure.
steps.safety_note: High motor current (9.2 A) approaching thermal overload limit (10.0 A).

steps.instruction: If pressure remains above the limit, follow the applicable shutdown procedure.
steps.detail: If pressure does not normalize below 5.2 bar within 120 seconds of valve trim, trip Pump-02 via emergency stop push button or DCS permissive sequence.
steps.safety_note: Overpressure protection burst disc threshold is 8.0 bar.

steps.instruction: Escalate to maintenance if valve malfunction is suspected.
steps.detail: Contact mechanical maintenance dispatch (Ext. 4410) and log work order for actuator recalibration or trim debris clearance.
steps.safety_note: Complete shift handover log entry before shift change.
